title: Introduce yourself
body: Use /introduce in the introductions channel. Create, Edit and Preview are private buttons inside one Chairs frame. Publish is an explicit separate action; previews match the public card. Editing updates your existing introduction.

fields.answers: Five separate private fields ask what to call you, drug of choice, controversial opinion, last meal, and favorite chair. Optional blank answers appear as Not shared on the card.

steps: Open /introduce in the configured introductions channel.
Choose Create or Edit and complete the five separate private fields.
Use Preview to check the complete public card.
Choose Publish only when ready; leaving the private form does not publish.
Use Edit later to update the same introduction.
